entities.summary: The Anselmianum, also known as the Pontifical Athenaeum of Saint Anselm or simply Sant'Anselmo, is a pontifical university in Rome associated with the Benedictines. It offers courses in philosophy, theology, liturgy, monastic studies, languages, sacramental theology, and the history of theology. Pontificio Ateneo Sant Anselmo is a university in Europe, established in 1887. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
